checkpoints.title: AskRequest/AskResponse contract and its generated JSON Schema
contracts: contracts/ask.schema.json generated from the Go types (invopop/jsonschema); AskResponse.Check: answered quotes and cites, referred and refused explain and cite nothing

checkpoints.title: Ask workflow: screen, retrieve, ground, respond, record
contracts: ask.Service.Ask(user, question) returns a contract-valid AskResponse and records question_asked plus one outcome event through ask.Recorder; Visit records benefits_visit
instrumentation: product events benefits_visit, question_asked, answer_grounded, answer_referred, answer_refused (no question text)

checkpoints.title: HTTP boundary: POST /api/ask and GET /healthz
contracts: POST /api/ask: application/json AskRequest (unknown fields refused, 4 KiB cap) -> 200 AskResponse or 4xx contracts.Error; GET /healthz -> 200 ok
